meta.description: Net-new events merged during this refresh. Window: 2026-10-18 to 10-24. Accenture added two official signals: Gemini Launchpads with Google Public Sector for US federal agencies (10-19) and the TÜV SÜD Physical AI Safety Suite with NVIDIA unveiled at GTC Berlin (10-21, digital certification could bring production online up to 30% sooner). One documented backfill from the 10-17 round missed during the search outage: Oliver Wyman Forum's The AI Reality Check (10-15), which incorporates the NYSE CEO Agenda 2026 survey of 415 CEOs and resolves the three-round hold. Full 17-firm sweep completed with the search provider recovered: Deloitte, KPMG, PwC, EY, Bain, Capgemini, Roland Berger, FTI Consulting, Alvarez & Marsal, and L.E.K. had no verifiable net-new signals in the window (EY's Oct 20 European release is a regional rollout of its Oct 7 global CEO Outlook; Capgemini's Oct 20 Hi PARIS renewal and Bain's Oct 23 snap chart lacked first-party links and were held). A follow-up browser re-check of newsrooms that search had under-covered found four more net-new events: Deloitte's first-to-market Frontline Workforce Management solution (10-20, AI-powered scheduling with quantified airline results), KPMG and Microsoft's Frontier Innovation Hub for trusted agentic AI (10-21), and two L.E.K. research pieces (Warehouse Automation AI 10-23, European Brand Packaging AI survey 10-21).

events.title: Accenture Federal Services 与 Google Public Sector 设立 Gemini Launchpads，为美国联邦机构快速构建专属 AI agents
events.title_en: Accenture Federal Services and Google Public Sector establish Gemini Launchpads for purpose-built federal AI agents
events.summary: Accenture 于 2026-10-19 宣布 Accenture Federal Services 与 Google Public Sector 设立 Gemini Launchpads，帮助美国联邦机构构建、部署并规模化专属 AI agents，把生成式 AI 接入任务工作流；Accenture 将训练首批 Google Cloud 认证工程师，纳入其千人工程师计划。这是继 Gemini Enterprise Business Group 之后 Accenture-Google 联盟向联邦市场的延伸。
events.summary_en: On October 19, 2026, Accenture Federal Services and Google Public Sector established Gemini Launchpads to help US federal agencies build, deploy, and scale purpose-built AI agents and integrate generative AI into mission workflows, with Accenture training an initial cohort of Google Cloud-skilled engineers as part of its broader 1,000-person effort.

events.title: Accenture 与 TÜV SÜD 在 GTC 柏林发布 Physical AI Safety Suite：数字认证可让产线提前 30% 投产
events.title_en: Accenture and TÜV SÜD unveil Physical AI Safety Suite with NVIDIA at GTC Berlin
events.summary: Accenture 于 2026-10-21（柏林）在 NVIDIA GTC 上与 TÜV SÜD 联合发布 Physical AI Safety Suite 概念：用数字孪生与 AI 仿真加速自动导引车等机器人的安全部署与认证，TÜV SÜD 估计数字认证方式可使产线提前最多 30% 投产。这是 Accenture 在物理 AI 安全与认证方向的首个联合方案。
events.summary_en: On October 21, 2026 in Berlin, Accenture and TÜV SÜD unveiled their joint Physical AI Safety Suite concept at NVIDIA GTC, using digital twins and AI simulations to speed safe deployment of robots such as AMRs, with digital certification potentially bringing production online up to 30% sooner.

events.title: Oliver Wyman Forum 发布《The AI Reality Check》：整合 NYSE CEO Agenda 2026 的 415 位 CEO 调查（上轮漏检回填）
events.title_en: Oliver Wyman Forum releases The AI Reality Check: Strategy, Governance, Workforce
events.summary: Oliver Wyman Forum 于 2026-10-15 发布 The AI Reality Check: Strategy, Governance, Workforce，超越 AI 炒作，基于消费者研究、包含 Oliver Wyman Forum × NYSE CEO Agenda 2026（415 位 CEO）的深度调查以及 Quotient, AI by Oliver Wyman 的专业能力，给出 AI 战略、治理与劳动力的务实框架。该报告同时解开了此前连续三轮挂账的'OW Forum × NYSE CEO 调查'之谜——其核心调查即本报告组成部分。发布于 10-17 轮窗口内，因搜索故障漏检，本轮经搜索恢复后回填。
events.summary_en: On October 15, 2026, the Oliver Wyman Forum released The AI Reality Check: Strategy, Governance, Workforce, going beyond the AI hype with consumer research, the Oliver Wyman Forum x NYSE CEO Agenda 2026 survey of 415 CEOs, and Quotient, AI by Oliver Wyman expertise. It resolves the previously unverified OW-NYSE CEO survey hold; missed during the 10-17 round's search outage and backfilled after the search provider recovered.

events.title: KPMG 与 Microsoft 启动 Frontier Innovation Hub：加速可信 agentic AI 的企业级采用
events.title_en: KPMG and Microsoft launch Frontier Innovation Hub to accelerate trusted agentic AI at enterprise scale
events.summary: KPMG 于 2026-10-21 宣布与 Microsoft 开启合作新阶段：开设 KPMG and Microsoft Frontier Innovation Hub 共创环境，帮助组织加速采用可信的 agentic AI。这是 KPMG 在 CT&I 集团、Claude Digital Gateway、Workday/Google Cloud 体验层之后的又一个 AI 共创基础设施动作。
events.summary_en: On October 21, 2026, KPMG and Microsoft announced a new phase of their collaboration with the opening of the KPMG and Microsoft Frontier Innovation Hub, a co-innovation environment designed to help organizations accelerate the adoption of trusted agentic AI.

events.title: Deloitte 发布首批上市的一线劳动力管理解决方案：AI 排班已为全球十大航空公司收回数十万小时
events.title_en: Deloitte launches first-to-market Frontline Workforce Management solution
events.summary: Deloitte 于 2026-10-20 发布一线劳动力管理解决方案（首创上市），把排班竞标、换班、休假、合规计算与人力成本分析统一到基于 AWS、Infor 与 ServiceNow 的连接系统；已在一家全球前十航空公司落地——自动化排班收回数十万小时、自主换班使缺勤率下降 15%。AI 能力包括智能任务优先级管理与集体谈判场景的实时建模。
events.summary_en: On October 20, 2026, Deloitte launched its first-to-market Frontline Workforce Management solution, unifying shift bidding, swaps, time-off, compliance, and labor cost analysis on a connected system built on AWS, Infor, and ServiceNow — already delivering for a top 10 global airline with hundreds of thousands of hours recovered and a 15% drop in absenteeism from autonomous shift swaps, with AI-powered task prioritization and real-time collective bargaining modeling.

events.title: L.E.K. 发布《Warehouse Automation》：AI、机器人与履约的未来
events.title_en: L.E.K. publishes Warehouse Automation: AI, Robotics and the Future of Fulfilment
events.summary: L.E.K. 于 2026-10-23 发布工业设备研究，讨论 AI 与机器人如何重塑仓储自动化与履约体系，延续其从软件 AI 向物理 AI 延伸的覆盖线。
events.summary_en: On October 23, 2026, L.E.K. published research on warehouse automation, examining how AI and robotics are reshaping fulfilment, continuing its coverage line extending from software AI into physical AI.

events.title: L.E.K. 发布欧洲品牌包装调查 2026：数字与 AI 工具把包装数据变成执行优势
events.title_en: L.E.K. publishes European Brand Packaging Survey 2026: digital and AI tools turn packaging data into execution advantage
events.summary: L.E.K. 于 2026-10-21 发布欧洲品牌包装年度调查，聚焦数字与 AI 工具如何把包装数据转化为执行优势，把 AI 议题延伸到包装与消费品类。
events.summary_en: On October 21, 2026, L.E.K. published its European Brand Packaging Survey 2026, focusing on how digital and AI tools turn packaging data into execution advantage, extending AI coverage into packaging and consumer categories.
